_contract: Block registry for the page builder. Owner: coordinator. Lane C turns each entry into a Sanity object type, lane D into an Astro component at src/components/blocks/<Name>.astro, lane S reads `jsonld`, lane M maps Webflow sections with `match`. Every live Webflow section must match exactly one entry (check: python3 -I migration/tools/check-contracts.py). Change requests go through lanes/<lane>/STATUS.md.

layout._note: Rendered by the layout, not stored as page sections.

match.component: Custom Code (must be on every page)

fields.title: string?
fields.intro: text? (line under the title; for tools, the caption above the logos)

blocks.purpose: Tagline, heading, body with optional media. Covers Problem, Krok N, Moduł N, Tygodnie X-Y, Obszar N, Bonus N and home service anchors
Tagline, heading and a list or grid of items. Covers Dla kogo, Jak pracuję, Efekty, Co dostajesz, Moje usługi, Granice, Zakres

match.component: Empty Section / Title Left Plus Tagline

fields.heading: string
fields.plans: {name, price:number, currency:'PLN', unit:string, priceNote?, features:string[], cta:link, highlighted:boolean}[]

blocks.jsonld: Offer nodes with UnitPriceSpecification, attached to the page's #service or #course

blocks.purpose: Quotes or an image wall of recommendations
Cross-link to another page, today always Sales Atlas System

blocks.jsonld: FAQPage <url>#faq when emitSchema and the block is visible; at most one per page

blocks.purpose: Lead form posting to /api/form (Worker → n8n), with 32 attribution fields

fields.heading: string?
fields.channels: {tagline?, heading?, groups: {title, note?, items: {kind:'linkedin'|'github'|'x'|'youtube'|'instagram'|'email'|'phone'|'signal'|'whatsapp', label, href:https|mailto|tel}[]}[]}? (full or channels; replaces the person-based details column)

blocks.purpose: Latest N posts of one kind, e.g. 'Ostatnie wpisy' on /newsletter and /o-mnie. The page query resolves the posts
blocks.jsonld: none (no ItemList; the posts carry their own BlogPosting on their pages)
blocks._note: No match rule: on live the list is a w-dyn-list inside a blog-article section, which matches richText. The page importer (T20) splits that list off into a postList.

blocks.purpose: Long-form text on static pages (legal, about) using the same Portable Text as posts
Accessible vertical tabs preserving all pane links

diagramKeys._note: Animated diagrams are code, not content. Editors pick a key; lane D implements src/components/diagrams/<Key>.astro. Keys come from the embed ids in Webflow. Lane M extends this list from live-site/html if it finds more.
